items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I was working with a cat named Joe Cephus

ctx.x: Yeah. He had a band in St. Paul. I was working with a cat named Joe Cephus, and I left him to go with this Al Herbert, but really he wanted me to play tenor, and shit, I wasn't no tenor player.
Had you played any reeds since you put the clarinet down?
